query: Synapse Network MCP server for paid API calls
answer_summary:
To monetize your Synapse MCP server by charging for API calls, you can integrate with platforms like Dock0 and MCPay.

**Dock0** enables you to add per-call billing, authentication, and payouts to your existing MCP server. By connecting your server to Dock0, you can set a price per successful call, and Dock0 handles billing, authentication, and payouts automatically. This allows you to monetize your server without modifying its code. ([dock0.dev](https://www.dock0.dev/?utm_source=openai))

**MCPay** provides a payment layer for MCP and HTTP servers, implementing the x402 protocol. This protocol allows clients to call your tool, receive payment requirements with price metadata, pay on-chain, and retry automatically. MCPay is designed for providers who want to monetize per-call access to their APIs or tools. ([docs.mcpay.tech](https://docs.mcpay.tech/faq?utm_source=openai))

By integrating your Synapse MCP server with Dock0 or MCPay, you can effectively monetize your API calls, ensuring secure and efficient transactions for your users.
